name: Revdoku
description: Cloud storage with an email address for every bucket. Store and share files with authorized people and AI agents; receive email and attachments.

skills.name: Private cloud storage for AI
skills.description: Store, read, write, append, and restore files through authorized account connections. Humans and authorized AI apps collaborate on the same files and folders without creating a preview or website.

skills.name: Buckets that receive email
skills.description: Each bucket has an incoming address. Check receiving readiness, compare received_count for new mail, then read message.json, message.eml, and attachments through authorized file access.

skills.name: Preview a bucket website
skills.description: Only for accounts with features.website_publishing enabled; disabled for new accounts on all plans. Preview an authenticated bucket draft for 24 hours using its selected access settings. Poll bucket_publication_get until ready or failed.

skills.name: Manage account websites
skills.description: Only for accounts with features.website_publishing enabled; disabled for new accounts on all plans. Create buckets, manage files, publish or update sites, and inspect publication state through authenticated MCP tools.
